children: EnerSys (ENS) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 14, 2026.

On October 14, 2026, EnerSys announced that Navi Grewal has been appointed as Chief Digital, AI and Information Officer. A copy of the press release announcing Ms. Grewal's appointment is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1289308/000128930826000018/ens-20261014.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1289308/000128930826000018/0001289308-26-000018-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
